pages.text: Item Pipes transport items across a network to connected containers and machines.$(br2)$(bold)Four speeds$(reset) (items per tick):$(li)Item Pipe: 1/t$(li)Intermediate Item Pipe (_advanced): 4/t$(li)Advanced Item Pipe (_elite): 16/t$(li)Ultimate Item Pipe (_ultimate): 64/t$(br2)Pipes connect only to containers and this mod's machines that support pipe access. By default each end is two-way; the Configurator can switch a section to Push/Pull or sever one side.

$(bold)Logistics:$(reset)$(li)power uses $(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l)$(li)items use Item Pipes$(li)liquids use fluid pipes (see $(l:akaishi:liquid_fuel)Liquid Fuel Chain$(/l))$(br2)The three networks are independent and can run side by side. Typical line: the Collector harvests → Item Pipes move the Essence → a machine processes it.$(br2)Machines such as the $(l:akaishi:plant_cultivator)Plant Cultivator$(/l) also accept pipes, enabling fully automatic farming.
For a full automation line, combine them with the $(l:akaishi:collector)Auto Collector$(/l); the power side is covered in $(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l).
